content:
Executive compensation can look complicated, but complicated doesn’t mean impossible to understand.

RSUs, bonuses, stock awards, deferred compensation, and other executive benefits all leave a paper trail. The key is knowing which documents to request, how the compensation structure works, and what questions to ask.

Too often, uncertainty comes from asking the wrong professional the wrong question. When you have someone who understands executive compensation digging into the documentation, you can start calculating the full value and uncovering what the income picture actually looks like.

The paperwork tells the story. You just need to know how to read it.

👉 follow @divorceanalytics for the analysis that shows you the reality behind the story.
